title: Fresh Beans' triggered ability never fires when a unit is played during a showdown
expected: Fresh Beans (unl-011-219) rulesText parses via trigger-patterns.ts:278-283 to event play-unit with restrictions [{type:"during-showdown"}]. trigger-matcher.ts:171-173 handles `case "during-showdown": return false;` unconditionally (TODO: showdown state not exposed), so the restriction can never be satisfied and the triggered ability never fires, matching the observed no-prompt/no-exhaust behavior.
observed: 4 Recruit unit tokens entered base during the showdown (passShowdownFocus still available, UI banner 'Showdown in progress — your focus'); Fresh Beans stayed exhausted:false, no chain item, no pendingChoice, hand size unchanged (6). Root cause in engine: abilities/trigger-matcher.ts restriction `case "during-showdown": return false` (TODO) — the parsed trigger (event play-unit + restriction during-showdown from trigger-patterns.ts) can never match.

history.note: trigger-matcher: during-showdown restriction reads interaction.showdownStack instead of always false

resolution.note: trigger-matcher: during-showdown restriction reads interaction.showdownStack instead of always false
